take: One 97 Communications has recovered revenue growth to 28.5% YoY and operating margin to 10% in Q2 FY27 after severe FY25 contractions. However, FY26 operating cash flow was deeply negative at -₹743 crore despite reported PAT, making a 125x P/E multiple heavily reliant on achieving guided 15-20% margins.

promises.promise: Achieve 15-20% margin in the near term with higher confidence
promises.delivered: OPM reached 10% in Q2 FY27 up from 8% in Q1 FY27

promises.promise: 2.5 bps margin upside from MDR on UPI implementation
Broadly add 25 to 30 lakhs devices a year
Offset at least 30-40 percent of PIDF impact this quarter
promises.delivered: Q4 FY26 revenue reached ₹2,264 crore and OPM held at 6%

promises.promise: Make Paytm Money a top five player in less than three years

narrative.claim: Revenue growth is accelerating across segments with operating leverage driving expanding margins
narrative.numbers: Revenue rose 28.5% YoY to ₹2,648 crore in Q2 FY27 with OPM expanding to 10%

narrative.claim: Business model compounding has returned the company to structural full-year profitability
narrative.numbers: FY26 PAT was ₹552 crore, but CFO deteriorated to negative ₹743 crore

narrative.claim: Higher marketing and cashback spends are driving engagement and long-term retention rather than low-value users
narrative.numbers: Marketing spends grew sequentially without corresponding increases in marketing services revenue or MTU acceleration

guidance.latest: 2.5 bps upside from MDR on UPI implementation
Achieve 15-20% margin in the near term
Add 25 to 30 lakhs devices a year

bull.point: Revenue growth accelerated to 28.5% YoY in Q2 FY27 with quarterly operating margin reaching 10%.
Merchant device subscription base surpassed 1.51 crore merchants, targeting 25-30 lakh device additions annually.
Balance sheet is virtually debt-free with D/E of 0.02 and potential 2.5 bps UPI margin accretion upcoming.

bear.point: Operating cash flow turned negative at -₹743 crore in FY26 despite reported PAT of ₹552 crore.
Stock P/E ratio is high at 125x against a modest reported ROCE of 4.96%.
P2M GMV remained flat sequentially in Q2 FY27 as firm exited unprofitable large merchant contracts.

watch: EBITDA margin expansion toward the guided 15-20% target band
Cash flow from operations convergence with reported quarterly profits
Delivery of guided 2.5 bps payment processing margin expansion from UPI
